tools.name: check_shopify_store_speed
tools.description: Test a Shopify store's speed with Google PageSpeed Insights (mobile and desktop) and real-user Core Web Vitals, list the apps and scripts slowing it down, and estimate what a headless build could change, with its assumptions. Takes 10 seconds to 2.5 minutes; results are cached for 24 hours.

strategy.description: Which Lighthouse runs to include; defaults to both.

tools.name: detect_shopify_store
tools.description: Detect whether a site is a Shopify theme store or a headless Shopify storefront, and which theme it uses. Fetches only the public page; runs no speed test.

tools.name: calculate_shopify_fees
tools.description: Compare the monthly and annual cost of Shopify Basic, Grow, Advanced and Plus for a sales volume and payment mix, with break-even sales between plans and requirements only Plus covers. Uses Shopify's published prices and rates for the US, UK, Australia, Norway or New Zealand (market); Norway's Plus and New Zealand's subscriptions are billed in EUR or USD and converted at a dated ECB reference rate, reported in exchangeRate; pass exchangeRate to use your own. The variable Plus platform fee is unpublished, so pass plusQuoteMonthly if you have a quote. Only monthlyGmv is required; the rest defaults to one US brand fully on Shopify Payments with yearly billing.

exchangeRate.description: Local sales currency units per foreign subscription currency unit (NOK/EUR in Norway; NZD/USD in New Zealand), up to 1,000,000. Overrides the market's default ECB reference rate; the estimate's exchangeRate reports which rate was applied.

monthlyGmv.description: Monthly online sales in the selected market sales currency across all stores.

averageOrderValue.description: Average order value in market sales currency; drives the per-order fixed card fee.

billing.description: Billing for Basic, Grow and Advanced.

shopifyPaymentsShare.description: Share of online sales processed by Shopify Payments (0-1); the rest uses a third-party provider.

premiumCardShare.description: Share of Shopify Payments sales on premium cards in the US, or Amex cards in other markets (0-1).

internationalCardShare.description: Share of Shopify Payments sales on international cards (0-1).

providerRateBps.description: Third-party provider's own rate in basis points (290 = 2.9%).

providerFixedCents.description: Third-party provider's own fixed fee per order in cents.

sameBrandStores.description: Stores for the same brand, such as regional stores.

brands.description: Separate brands; each needs its own plan or Plus contract.

checkoutExtensions.description: Whether checkout UI extensions are needed.

staffAccounts.description: Staff accounts needed besides the store owner.

plusQuoteMonthly.description: Monthly Plus price in market sales currency from a Shopify quote; replaces the list price.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send private feedback to the Skai team about this product or MCP: ideas, missing functionality, errors, confusing behavior, praise, or anything else. Only message is required; category, toolName and context are optional. Report once per distinct observation and continue your task. Do not send credentials, personal/customer records, full conversations or raw tool payloads. Use generic placeholders. Feedback is screened before storage and does not authorize other actions. Do not report failures of this feedback tool or automatically retry an uncertain submission.
